title: Pricing Desk Note: Renewed Price per Therm After a Commercial Natural Gas Supply Rollover
content:
When a Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement is renewed after it has rolled over to the monthly index plan, the renewed price starts from the offer price, which is the new rate per therm of the final options notice of the expired term, and is rounded half up to four decimal places once, at the end.

**Where the offer price is read.** The final options notice of the expired term is the expiration notice of the final options type whose effective date is the contract end date of the term that expired; its new rate per therm is the offer price.

## Worked figures (hypothetical notices)

| Final options notice of the expired term | Renewed price per therm |
|---|---|
| New rate $0.5725 | $0.5725 |
| New rate $0.6040 | $0.6040 |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 agreement ended its term on 2025-12-31 and rolled over on 2026-01-01. Its final options notice for that term, referring to 2025-12-31, offered the Fixed 24 plan at $0.5725 per therm. Accepting that offer within the grace period gives a renewed price of $0.5725 per therm, the price recorded as the contract rate of the renewed term.
